BrochureContent.Content:
Hume Auctioneers - We Get The Pick Of The Crop

In 1170 The King Of Leinster, Diarmuid MacMurrough gifted Dunamase Castle to his daughter Aoife and her husband, the Norman conqueror Strongbow, to set up home. Almost a thousand years later, the area still reigns supreme and is regarded as the most prestigious residential area in the entire region.

Robin Hill is a breathtakingly beautiful 4-bedroom residence located at the foot of Dunamase Castle, occupying a stunning elevated position that ranks among the very finest in the county. 

The property boasts breathtaking, far-reaching views that have been admired for centuries?and now offers a rare opportunity for a new family to make this exceptional setting their own.
 
The area is one of spectacular natural beauty with exceptional country and woodland walks right on your doorstep.

Sitting on almost one acre of professionally landscaped gardens, the entire is almost majestic. 

The superbly appointed residence, offers an impressive balance of refined living and contemporary comfort, thoughtfully laid out to maximise space, light and functionality.

From the moment you enter the welcoming entrance hall, the home sets a tone of understated elegance. The layout flows effortlessly into the principal reception spaces, all of which are generously proportioned and beautifully light-filled.

At the heart of the home lies a spacious kitchen and breakfast room which opens onto a tiled patio, designed for modern family living. This bright and practical space connects seamlessly to both the formal dining room and the adjoining sitting room, creating an ideal arrangement for entertaining and day-to-day life alike.

The formal dining room is a particularly impressive space, with large windows framing the gardens and allowing natural light to pour in, while the adjacent sitting room offers a more relaxed setting for evening retreat. The finishes are exceptional with beautiful fireplaces and quality fittings everywhere.

To the opposite side of the home, the second living room provides a relaxed and peaceful space, centred around a feature fireplace and complemented by a charming sun lounge. This additional reception area enjoys panoramic garden views and captures sunlight throughout the day, offering a tranquil setting for relaxation.

The bedroom accommodation is thoughtfully positioned along a separate wing, ensuring privacy and comfort. The principal bedroom suite is generously proportioned and benefits from its own ensuite, while the remaining bedrooms are all spacious and well-appointed. Each bedroom enjoys exceptional wardrobe space. A large family bathroom completes the accommodation.

Throughout the home, expansive windows enhance the sense of space and light, while the interiors have been meticulously maintained, presenting a turnkey opportunity for the discerning purchaser.

This fine home combines classic design with a layout perfectly suited to modern living, offering multiple reception areas, excellent flow between spaces, and a wonderful connection to the surrounding gardens.

Outside there is a large double integrated garage which could easily convert for a multitude of uses.

The remote controlled ( Hive) heating system is of the highest specification. With Solar Panels, Dual central heating including Oil and Wood pellet systems, the property boasts an impressive B3 rating meaning not only are your heating bills super low, the property also qualifies for a low-interest rate Green Mortgage.

The garden at Robin Hill was planned by a designer/ horticulturist and has beautifully evolved and matured over the years.

There is year-round interest with winter flowering shrubs, spring bulbs, herbaceous plants and many well-established evergreen and deciduous trees.
Summer has wonderful colour with flowering shrubs and roses and is a haven for birds, butterflies and bees.
There are raised beds for strawberries, salads, vegetables, herbs and rhubarb for jam and chutney!

High speed broadband available.

Choice of excellent primary and secondary schools nearby. Portlaoise less than 10 minutes. M7 Motorway 5 minutes. Dublin less than an hour.

Viewing Highly Recommended
